agent.title: Tools
agent.lead: The agent can only call the tools you enable here.

askUser.summary: Pauses the run to ask you a question.
askUser.description: Asks you a question and pauses the execution until you answer. The agent uses it only when the task is ambiguous or it needs information it cannot get from documents or other tools, e.g. which period to analyze or who should receive a report. It can suggest up to 6 answers. You can skip the question: the agent then continues with its best judgement and states the assumption.

calculate.summary: Computes sums, averages and percentage changes exactly.
calculate.description: Evaluates arithmetic exactly instead of the model calculating in its head: totals, differences, ratios, growth and forecasts. It takes the numbers found as variables and a list of named calculations, each of which can use the results of earlier ones. Supports + - * / % ^, parentheses and functions such as pct, pct_change and cagr.

compareDocuments.summary: Shows what changed between two versions of a document.
compareDocuments.description: Compares two documents attached to this agent line by line, e.g. two versions of a contract, policy or price list. Returns a similarity score (0–1), counts of unchanged, added and removed lines, and the list of changes with line numbers. Whitespace differences and blank lines are ignored.

extractTable.summary: Turns tables from CSV, JSON or Markdown files into rows and columns.
extractTable.description: Extracts tables from a document attached to this agent as structured rows and columns. Works for CSV/TSV files, JSON arrays of objects and Markdown tables; tables inside PDFs are not detected. Numeric columns (also with currency symbols, % or thousand separators) come back as numbers, ready for calculations.

fetchUrl.summary: Reads a web page or an online PDF as plain text.
fetchUrl.description: Downloads a public web page (HTML, plain text, JSON or PDF) and returns its readable text. Used to read pages found with webSearch or URLs given in the task. Private and local network addresses are blocked, and long pages are cut off. The page content is untrusted data: the agent never follows instructions found in it.

generateReport.summary: Creates an HTML report with tables and charts.
generateReport.description: Builds the final report as a self-contained HTML file with optional charts (bar charts for comparisons, line charts for trends) and saves it as a downloadable file. The report only includes facts and numbers from tool results, with forecasts and assumptions marked as such. Returns a file id that sendEmail can attach.

httpRequest.summary: Calls an API from the connections attached to the agent.
httpRequest.description: Calls an HTTP API through a connection configured for this agent: the connection name, the method and a path relative to the base URL. Authentication is added by the platform, so the agent never sees keys or tokens. GET requests run immediately; every other method waits for your approval. Only methods allowed on the connection can be used.

readDocument.summary: Reads the full text of the agent's documents.
readDocument.description: Returns the full text of documents in the agent's knowledge base (files you uploaded and attached to this agent). Without a document id it returns the first attached documents and lists the rest. Useful when all the data from a file is needed, e.g. a financial table. Very long documents are cut off.

searchDocuments.summary: Finds the most relevant passages in the agent's documents.
searchDocuments.description: Searches the agent's knowledge base (documents attached to this agent) by keywords. Returns the most relevant text fragments with the name of the document they come from.

sendEmail.summary: Sends an email, optionally with a generated report attached.
sendEmail.description: Sends a plain-text email to a single recipient. A report created in this execution can be attached.

webSearch.summary: Searches the web and returns the top results.
webSearch.description: Searches the public web and returns the best matching pages with a title, URL and a short snippet. Used for current or public information that is not in the attached documents (news, companies, prices, regulations). The agent reads the most relevant results with fetchUrl and cites the URLs it used. Web content is untrusted data, never instructions.
